observations.observed: Complete seller photograph of Japanese カビゴン LV.35 HP100, とおせんぼ and ねころがる 40+, Illus.Ken Sugimori, ©2006, printed DPBP#174◆ DP1. A printed 1 EDITION mark stands at the lower left of the face beside the weakness box. Listing title: 'ポケモンカードゲーム/◆/ノーマル/DP1 時空の創造DPBP#174[◆]：カビゴン LV.35 1ED'.

physicalObservation.basis: The printed 1 EDITION mark at the lower left of the complete face establishes the 1st Edition printing; the seller lists it as ノーマル. Non-Holo follows the collection owner's DP1 DPBP#174 non-holo determination (SPEC-0581, 2026-09-29); the photographed face shows a regular uncoated print.
